prepareInstallation.description: Deploys the Substrate, AnchorElection, AutonetVault, AutonetRepClaim, ToolBond, ServiceRegistry, and PaymentChannel, wired to the DAO, and records the charter its daemons follow.

components.name: challengeWindow
components.description: How long a counterparty has to challenge a payment channel close.

components.name: charter
components.description: The charter the daemons follow: JSON {"axes":[{"id","thesis"}]}, which must include the axes correctness and simplicity. Recorded in full as jurisdiction.autonet.charter; daemons hash its exact bytes. The DAO changes it by proposal, effective from the next epoch.

x-ui.label: Charter
x-ui.default: {"axes":[{"id":"life_precious","thesis":"Life is precious and should be preserved."},{"id":"self_preservation","thesis":"The system should preserve its own continuity."},{"id":"promotion_of_intelligence","thesis":"Intelligence in any form should be promoted."},{"id":"evolution","thesis":"Forward advancement of capability is desirable."},{"id":"correctness","thesis":"Work should achieve what it claims and avoid bugs."},{"id":"simplicity","thesis":"Solutions should be minimal and direct, not over-engineered."}]}

components.name: epochRules
components.description: The version of the epoch rules the daemons must support, recorded as jurisdiction.autonet.epoch_rules. It changes only when the epoch math changes.

components.name: genesisRoot
components.description: Only for a fork or split of an existing network: the merkle root of ATN balances carried over, which holders claim once with Substrate.claimGenesis. Fixed for good. Empty for a new network.

components.name: serviceFeeBps
components.description: The fee the Substrate takes on every service payment. The DAO changes it by proposal (setServiceFeeBps).

components.name: feeTreasuryBps
components.description: The share of the service fee paid to the treasury; the rest is burned and funds the tool pool. The DAO changes it by proposal (setFeeTreasuryBps).

x-ui.label: Share of the fee to the treasury (%)

components.name: minStake
components.description: ATN an author must stake behind each published tool. Nodes ignore unstaked tools.

components.name: revealWindow
components.description: Time agents have to reveal their epoch's hidden reviews once the epoch is anchored.

components.name: degradeBps
components.description: REP a fully wrong review loses (less the closer it lands), and what a batch that is never revealed loses.

components.name: authorSlashBps
components.description: REP the author of a tool settled as fully harmful loses; it scales with the settled harm and is burned.

components.name: unbondDelay
components.description: How long a stake stays reviewable after its author asks to withdraw. Keep it longer than an epoch plus the reveal window, or an unbond can leave before that epoch's reviews are revealed.

components.name: reviewerShareBps
components.description: Share of a tool's earnings that goes to its reviewers; the author keeps the rest.

components.name: appealPeriod
components.description: The window to register a DAO overrule proposal against a settled harm, before payouts and slashes. A proposal registered in time holds the round until it can execute.

components.name: harmWeightBps
components.description: How much harm counts in a review's accuracy, against a charter axis at 100%. Higher makes misjudging harm cost more.

components.name: harmQuorumBps
components.description: Share of the epoch's REP supply that must score a tool's harm before that harm settles and slashes anything. Below it, harm still counts in the tool's rating.

prepareUninstallation.description: Revokes the REP claim's minting rights and ToolBond's slashing rights, and clears the jurisdiction.autonet.* entries. The daemon stops seeing this jurisdiction as an Autonet one.
